source_quote.quote: Note: In patients without prior biopsy, diagnosis will be suspected preoperatively, but must be confirmed by molecular testing (i.e., must be IDH wild type).
Patients with either methylated or unmethylated MGMT promoter status are included, and this status must be confirmed by central pathology review.

coder_notes: Registered phase is PHASE4 (excluded at S3 by script). Only investigational intervention is GammaTile, a Cs-131 brachytherapy device (radiotherapy, not a drug), so no pharmacological candidate. Temozolomide is the Stupp backbone. 5-ALA/fluorescein for fluorescence-guided resection mentioned only in eligibility as institutional standard, not a registered intervention, so not listed. MGMT status must be tested but either status is eligible (coded exploratory_correlative, not eligibility); indeterminate MGMT is excluded from the PP population only.
